blocks.zh: Section 1 — Moulded Glass Containers: Nonconformity Lexicon 模造玻璃容器不符合項詞典
blocks.en: Section 1 — Moulded Glass Containers: Nonconformity Lexicon Nonconformity lexicon for moulded glass containers

blocks.zh: 🎓 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: 🎓 Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解模造玻璃容器（Moulded Glass）的製造工藝與管制重點，並能與管式玻璃（Tubular Glass）進行比較分析。
blocks.en: Understand the manufacturing process and control priorities of moulded glass containers, and be able to compare them with tubular glass.

blocks.zh: 掌握 PDA TR43 附錄 8.0 中模造玻璃容器各類不符合項（Nonconformity）的定義、分類依據（Critical / Major A / Major B / Minor / Acceptable Imperfection）與風險評估邏輯。
blocks.en: Master the definitions, classification basis (Critical / Major A / Major B / Minor / Acceptable Imperfection) and risk assessment logic for each type of nonconformity of moulded glass containers in PDA TR43 Appendix 8.0.

blocks.zh: 熟悉不符合項的檢驗位置（Finish、Body、Bottom、General 等）及其對容器密封完整性（Container Closure Integrity, CCI）與無菌保障之影響。
blocks.en: Become familiar with the inspection locations of nonconformities (Finish, Body, Bottom, General, etc.) and their impact on container closure integrity (CCI) and sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 能根據不符合項的特性，判斷其主要風險（CCI/Sterility、User Injury、Remote Risk、Machinability、Aesthetic）並連結至適當的 AQL 抽樣計畫與供應商管制策略。
blocks.en: Based on the characteristics of a nonconformity, determine its main risk (CCI/Sterility, User Injury, Remote Risk, Machinability, Aesthetic) and link it to the appropriate AQL sampling plan and supplier control strategy.

blocks.zh: Appendix 8.0 — Inspection Methodology Overview 附錄 8.0：檢驗方法論概述
blocks.en: Appendix 8.0 — Inspection Methodology Overview Overview of the inspection methodology in Appendix 8.0

blocks.zh: 教學解說 — 附錄方法論
blocks.en: Commentary — Appendix Methodology

blocks.zh: 🏭 模造玻璃 vs. 管式玻璃：核心差異
blocks.en: 🏭 Moulded vs. Tubular Glass: Core Differences

blocks.zh: 模造玻璃（Moulded Glass）由熔融玻璃膏（gob）直接壓入金屬模具成形，生產速度快，適合大容量容器（50 mL–1000 mL 注射瓶）。
blocks.en: Moulded glass is formed by pressing a gob of molten glass directly into a metal mould. Production is fast and suits large-volume containers (50 mL–1000 mL injection bottles).

blocks.zh: 管式玻璃（Tubular Glass）先將玻璃熔融拉成管材，再由二次加工（Converting）製成小容量小瓶、安瓿、卡匣、針筒。
blocks.en: Tubular glass is first drawn from molten glass into tubing and then converted by secondary processing into small-volume vials, ampoules, cartridges and syringes.

blocks.zh: 模造：壁厚較均勻、不透明度較高、適合注射用水 (WFI) 容器
blocks.en: Moulded: more uniform wall thickness, higher opacity, suitable for water for injection (WFI) containers

blocks.zh: 管式：壁薄、透明度高、適合凍乾製劑小瓶與預填針
blocks.en: Tubular: thin wall, high transparency, suitable for lyophilized product vials and prefilled syringes

blocks.zh: TR43 表 8.0-1 涵蓋模造；表 8.0-2 至 8.0-5 涵蓋管式各類型
blocks.en: TR43 Table 8.0-1 covers moulded containers; Tables 8.0-2 to 8.0-5 cover the tubular types

blocks.zh: 🥦 比喻：玻璃檢驗就像稽核餐廳廚房
blocks.en: 🥦 Analogy: Glass Inspection Is Like Auditing a Restaurant Kitchen

blocks.zh: 想像你在稽核一間米其林餐廳的廚房。問題清單（Nonconformance Lexicon）就是你的稽核查核表，每一項缺陷都有：
blocks.en: Imagine you are auditing the kitchen of a Michelin-starred restaurant. The nonconformance lexicon is your audit checklist, and every defect has the following:

blocks.zh: 名稱（Nonconformance）：例如「砧板碎木屑」
blocks.en: Name (Nonconformance): for example, "wood splinters from the cutting board"

blocks.zh: 定義（Definition）：確保稽核員對同一現象有相同認知
blocks.en: Definition: makes sure auditors share the same understanding of the same phenomenon

blocks.zh: 分類（Classification）：吃進食物會直接中毒＝Critical；影響出餐效率＝Major B；只是外觀不美＝Minor
blocks.en: Classification: food that directly poisons the diner = Critical; slows down service = Major B; merely looks unattractive = Minor

blocks.zh: 位置（Location）：問題在「食品接觸面」（如 Finish）比在廚房地板（Body 外部）嚴重得多
blocks.en: Location: a problem on a "food contact surface" (such as the Finish) is far more serious than one on the kitchen floor (the exterior of the Body)

blocks.zh: 方法（Method）：目視、放大鏡、化學分析——相當於稽核員的不同稽查工具
blocks.en: Method: visual inspection, magnifier, chemical analysis; these are the auditor's different inspection tools

blocks.zh: PDA TR43 就是為全球玻璃製造商與製藥廠提供「相同語言」的詞典，確保供應商與客戶對每個缺陷的認定標準一致。
blocks.en: PDA TR43 is the lexicon that gives glass manufacturers and pharmaceutical companies worldwide a "common language", ensuring that suppliers and customers apply the same criteria to every defect.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 重點提示：為何「Finish」區域最關鍵？
blocks.en: ⚠️ Key Point: Why Is the "Finish" Area So Critical?

blocks.zh: Finish 是容器頸部開口與密封面（land surface），是橡皮塞接觸的區域。任何在 Finish 的缺陷若影響密封，就會危及：
blocks.en: The Finish is the container neck opening and sealing surface (land surface), the area the rubber stopper contacts. Any Finish defect that affects the seal endangers:

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性（Container Closure Integrity, CCI）
blocks.en: Container closure integrity (CCI)

blocks.zh: 無菌屏障（Sterility Assurance）
blocks.en: The sterile barrier (sterility assurance)

blocks.zh: 病患安全（Patient Safety）
blocks.en: Patient safety

blocks.zh: 這就是為何 Crack、Split Finish、Chipped Finish、Line Over Finish、Soft Blister（於 Finish 區）等都被列為 Critical 分類。
blocks.en: This is why Crack, Split Finish, Chipped Finish, Line Over Finish, Soft Blister (in the Finish area) and similar defects are all classified as Critical.

blocks.zh: 📊 AQL 0.65 在實務中的意義
blocks.en: 📊 What AQL 0.65 Means in Practice

blocks.zh: Major A 缺陷通常對應 AQL 0.65（依 ISO 2859-1 / ANSI/ASQ Z1.4）。
blocks.en: Major A defects usually correspond to AQL 0.65 (per ISO 2859-1 / ANSI/ASQ Z1.4).

blocks.zh: 以批量 10,000 支小瓶為例（General Inspection Level II）：
blocks.en: Take a lot size of 10,000 vials as an example (General Inspection Level II):

blocks.zh: 抽樣數 n = 200 支
blocks.en: Sample size n = 200 units

blocks.zh: 允收數 Ac = 1 支（Major A 缺陷）
blocks.en: Acceptance number Ac = 1 unit (Major A defects)

blocks.zh: 拒收數 Re = 2 支
blocks.en: Rejection number Re = 2 units

blocks.zh: 換言之，批量中若有 2 支以上 Major A 缺陷被抽到，整批就必須拒收。AQL 0.65 表示允許的不良品率僅 0.65%，極為嚴格，反映 Major A 對病患的潛在風險。
blocks.en: In other words, if 2 or more Major A defects are found in the sample, the whole lot must be rejected. AQL 0.65 allows a defect rate of only 0.65%, which is very strict and reflects the potential risk Major A defects pose to patients.

blocks.zh: ✍️ 練習思考 — 你能分類這些情境嗎？
blocks.en: ✍️ Exercise: Can You Classify These Scenarios?

blocks.zh: 一支 20 mL 模造玻璃小瓶，Finish 密封面上發現一道完整貫穿 100% land 面寬的溝槽（Line Over Finish）。應分類為何？
blocks.en: On a 20 mL moulded glass vial, a groove running across 100% of the land width is found on the Finish sealing surface (Line Over Finish). How should it be classified?

blocks.zh: 同一批次中，另一支小瓶的 Body 發現長度 1.0 mm 的 Check（玻璃表面未貫穿裂痕）。應分類為何？
blocks.en: In the same lot, another vial has a Check (a glass surface crack that does not go through the wall) 1.0 mm long on the Body. How should it be classified?

blocks.zh: 一支已洗淨的 Ready-to-Use（RTU）小瓶，外部 Body 發現 0.8 mm² 的非可移除異物（Non-removable contamination, exterior）。應分類為何？
blocks.en: A washed Ready-to-Use (RTU) vial has a 0.8 mm² non-removable foreign matter (non-removable contamination, exterior) on the exterior of the Body. How should it be classified?

blocks.zh: 參考答案： (1) Critical — Line Over Finish 完整橫越 100% land surface，直接危及 CCI/Sterility。 (2) Major A — Check ≥ 0.8 mm 屬 Major A（Remote risk to user：潛在裂縫擴展）。 (3) Minor — RTU 容器外部非可移除污染 ≥ 0.5 mm² 為 Minor（Aesthetic）。
blocks.en: Reference answers: (1) Critical: a Line Over Finish that fully crosses 100% of the land surface directly endangers CCI/sterility. (2) Major A: a Check ≥ 0.8 mm is Major A (remote risk to user: potential crack propagation). (3) Minor: non-removable exterior contamination ≥ 0.5 mm² on an RTU container is Minor (aesthetic).

blocks.zh: Table 8.0-1🔍 — Moulded Bottle and Vial Containers: Nonconformity Lexicon 模造瓶與小瓶容器不符合項詞典
blocks.en: Table 8.0-1🔍 — Moulded Bottle and Vial Containers: Nonconformity Lexicon Nonconformity lexicon for moulded bottles and vials

blocks.zh: 教學解說 — 不符合項分類邏輯
blocks.en: Commentary — Nonconformity Classification Logic

blocks.zh: 📈 分類決策樹：如何判定嚴重性？
blocks.en: 📈 Classification Decision Tree: How Is Severity Determined?

blocks.zh: TR43 的分類邏輯遵循「由嚴至寬」的判斷順序：
blocks.en: The TR43 classification logic follows a "strictest first" order of judgment:

blocks.zh: 是否影響 CCI / Sterility？ → Critical
blocks.en: Does it affect CCI / sterility? → Critical

blocks.zh: 是否直接傷害使用者（病患 / 醫護）？ → Critical
blocks.en: Does it directly injure the user (patient / healthcare worker)? → Critical

blocks.zh: 遠端風險（如裂縫擴展、粒子脫落）？ → Major A
blocks.en: Is there a remote risk (such as crack propagation or particle shedding)? → Major A

blocks.zh: 功能性（容器無法使用）？ → Major A
blocks.en: Is functionality lost (the container cannot be used)? → Major A

blocks.zh: 尺寸超規、影響生產線效率？ → Major B
blocks.en: Is it out of dimensional specification and does it reduce line efficiency? → Major B

blocks.zh: 可透過清洗去除的粒子？ → Minor（Negligible）
blocks.en: Are the particles removable by washing? → Minor (Negligible)

blocks.zh: 僅外觀問題？ → Minor 或 Acceptable Imperfection
blocks.en: Is it only an appearance issue? → Minor or Acceptable Imperfection

blocks.zh: 📌 Critical 缺陷摘要（本表 8.0-1）
blocks.en: 📌 Summary of Critical Defects (This Table 8.0-1)

blocks.zh: 以下為 Table 8.0-1🔍 中可能達到 Critical 分類的缺陷（按字母順序）：
blocks.en: The following defects in Table 8.0-1🔍 can reach a Critical classification (in alphabetical order):

blocks.zh: Adhered Glass — 若 seal integrity 受損
blocks.en: Adhered Glass: if seal integrity is compromised

blocks.zh: Chipped or Broken Finish — 若 seal integrity 受損
blocks.en: Chipped or Broken Finish: if seal integrity is compromised

blocks.zh: Contamination (Bulk & RTU) — 內表面不可移除 ≥0.1 mm²
blocks.en: Contamination (Bulk & RTU): non-removable on the inside surface, ≥0.1 mm²

blocks.zh: Crack — 全壁貫穿裂縫（Always Critical）
blocks.en: Crack: full-wall-penetrating crack (Always Critical)

blocks.zh: Inside Overpress / Wire Edge — ≥0.3 mm 突出或不均勻
blocks.en: Inside Overpress / Wire Edge: protrusion or unevenness ≥0.3 mm

blocks.zh: Knot — 若位於密封面且危及 CCI
blocks.en: Knot: if located on the sealing surface and endangering CCI

blocks.zh: Line Over Finish — 100% 橫越 land surface
blocks.en: Line Over Finish: crosses 100% of the land surface

blocks.zh: Malformed Finish — 若 seal integrity 受損
blocks.en: Malformed Finish: if seal integrity is compromised

blocks.zh: Rough Finish — 若 seal integrity 受損
blocks.en: Rough Finish: if seal integrity is compromised

blocks.zh: Soft Blister — 若位於 Finish 且危及 CCI
blocks.en: Soft Blister: if located in the Finish and endangering CCI

blocks.zh: Split Finish — Always Critical（垂直貫穿 Finish）
blocks.en: Split Finish: Always Critical (vertical split through the Finish)

blocks.zh: Stone — 若位於密封面且危及 CCI
blocks.en: Stone: if located on the sealing surface and endangering CCI

blocks.zh: 共同主題：多數 Critical 缺陷都與 Finish（密封區域） 直接相關，或是玻璃壁的全貫穿裂縫。
blocks.en: Common theme: most Critical defects are directly related to the Finish (sealing area) or are full-wall-penetrating cracks in the glass wall.

blocks.zh: 🔧 Major B 缺陷：尺寸與機械加工性
blocks.en: 🔧 Major B Defects: Dimensions and Machinability

blocks.zh: Major B 缺陷通常是尺寸類問題，影響後續製程（filling、capping、labeling）效率，但不直接危及病患：
blocks.en: Major B defects are usually dimensional problems that reduce the efficiency of downstream processes (filling, capping, labeling) but do not directly endanger the patient:

blocks.zh: Bent Neck、Leaner、Offset Finish — 影響封蓋機
blocks.en: Bent Neck, Leaner, Offset Finish: affect the capping machine

blocks.zh: Bulged Side、Sunken Side — 影響貼標機、傳送帶
blocks.en: Bulged Side, Sunken Side: affect the labeling machine and conveyor

blocks.zh: Choked Neck — 影響灌裝針頭進入
blocks.en: Choked Neck: affects entry of the filling needle

blocks.zh: Flared Bottom — 造成傳送帶卡瓶
blocks.en: Flared Bottom: causes vials to jam on the conveyor

blocks.zh: Loose Glass (RTU, Exterior) — 可能進入灌裝環境
blocks.en: Loose Glass (RTU, Exterior): may enter the filling environment

blocks.zh: Rolled In Finish、Inside Overpress — 阻礙橡皮塞插入
blocks.en: Rolled In Finish, Inside Overpress: hinder stopper insertion

blocks.zh: 📷 RTU vs. Bulk（未洗淨）：為何分類不同？
blocks.en: 📷 RTU vs. Bulk (Unwashed): Why Is the Classification Different?

blocks.zh: 同一缺陷（如 Loose Glass），在 Bulk（未洗淨） 容器中是 Minor（清洗可去除），但在 RTU（Ready-to-Use，已洗淨滅菌） 容器中升為 Major A（無後續清洗步驟保護）。
blocks.en: The same defect (such as Loose Glass) is Minor in a Bulk (unwashed) container (washing removes it), but is raised to Major A in an RTU (Ready-to-Use, washed and sterilized) container (no downstream washing step protects against it).

blocks.zh: 這體現了 PDA TR43 的核心哲學：風險分類必須考慮容器在供應鏈中的狀態，而非僅看缺陷本身的形態。
blocks.en: This reflects the core philosophy of PDA TR43: risk classification must take into account the state of the container in the supply chain, not only the form of the defect itself.

blocks.zh: RTU 容器直接進入無菌灌裝線，任何粒子或污染都沒有後續製程可以去除，故風險等級提高。
blocks.en: RTU containers go directly onto the aseptic filling line, with no later process step able to remove any particle or contamination, so the risk level is raised.

blocks.zh: 🔍 四種主要量測方法的應用場景
blocks.en: 🔍 Where the Four Main Measurement Methods Apply

blocks.zh: 目視 + 放大（eye loupe）：大多數尺寸型缺陷（Check, Scratch, Embedded Matter）
blocks.en: Visual + magnification (eye loupe): most dimensional-type defects (Check, Scratch, Embedded Matter)

blocks.zh: CCI 評估：所有 Finish 區域缺陷（Crack, Line Over Finish, Soft Blister）
blocks.en: CCI assessment: all Finish-area defects (Crack, Line Over Finish, Soft Blister)

blocks.zh: 化學分析（SEM EDS, FTIR）：污染物成分鑑定（Contamination, Swabbing Stain, Water Spot）
blocks.en: Chemical analysis (SEM EDS, FTIR): identifying the composition of contaminants (Contamination, Swabbing Stain, Water Spot)

blocks.zh: Flat surface 法：穩定性測試（Rocker, Leaner, Wavy Bottom）
blocks.en: Flat surface method: stability testing (Rocker, Leaner, Wavy Bottom)

blocks.zh: 當缺陷無法以尺寸判斷，通常使用「Limit Sample（限量樣品）」——由製藥廠與玻璃製造商共同確認的實體界限樣本。
blocks.en: When a defect cannot be judged by size, a "limit sample" is usually used: a physical boundary sample jointly agreed by the pharmaceutical company and the glass manufacturer.

blocks.zh: ✍️ 進階練習 — 現場情境判斷
blocks.en: ✍️ Advanced Exercise: Judging Shop-Floor Scenarios

blocks.zh: 情境 A：AVI（自動目視檢驗）在 RTU 小瓶批次中發現內壁上的 Swabbing Stain，面積經量測為 0.5 mm²。此時分類為？需要調查哪些根本原因？
blocks.en: Scenario A: Automated visual inspection (AVI) finds a Swabbing Stain on the inner wall of an RTU vial lot, measured at 0.5 mm². How is it classified? What root causes should be investigated?

blocks.zh: 情境 B：進料品質檢驗（IQC）抽樣時，在 15/200 支樣品中發現 Blank Seam（外觀超出 limit sample）。此批次 Bulk 模造瓶 AQL 的允收水準為 Minor AQL 4.0（n=200, Ac=14, Re=15）。應如何決定？
blocks.en: Scenario B: During incoming quality control (IQC) sampling, a Blank Seam (appearance beyond the limit sample) is found in 15 of 200 sampled units. The acceptance level for this Bulk moulded bottle lot is Minor AQL 4.0 (n=200, Ac=14, Re=15). How should the decision be made?

blocks.zh: 情境 C：一支小瓶在封蓋後 CCI 測試失敗，目視檢驗發現 Finish ID 有 0.35 mm 突出的 Inside Overpress。依 TR43 分類為何？需要採取哪些 CAPA？
blocks.en: Scenario C: A vial fails the CCI test after capping, and visual inspection finds an Inside Overpress protruding 0.35 mm on the Finish ID. How is it classified under TR43? What CAPA should be taken?

blocks.zh: 參考方向： (A) Major A（內表面 ≥0.3 mm²），根本原因應調查 Mould swabbing 頻率、compound 用量及模具溫度。 (B) 15 支 Minor 缺陷，Re=15，整批拒收（剛好到達拒收數）；建議向玻璃廠發出 SCAR 並要求 100% 篩選。 (C) Critical（≥0.3 mm，危及 CCI），立即隔離批次、進行 root cause analysis（模具磨損或壓力設定偏差）、實施 CAPA 並通知客戶。
blocks.en: Reference direction: (A) Major A (inside surface ≥0.3 mm²); the root cause investigation should cover mould swabbing frequency, compound quantity and mould temperature. (B) 15 Minor defects with Re=15 means the whole lot is rejected (the rejection number is just reached); issue a SCAR to the glass manufacturer and request 100% screening. (C) Critical (≥0.3 mm, endangers CCI): quarantine the lot immediately, perform root cause analysis (mould wear or pressure setting deviation), implement CAPA and notify the customer.

blocks.zh: Quick Reference — Classification Summary by Risk Type 分類快速參照表（依風險類型）
blocks.en: Quick Reference — Classification Summary by Risk Type Quick reference table of classification by risk type

blocks.zh: 關鍵概念複習 Key Concept Review
blocks.en: Key Concept Review

blocks.zh: 🌟 為何模造玻璃的不符合項詞典如此重要？
blocks.en: 🌟 Why Is the Moulded Glass Nonconformity Lexicon So Important?

blocks.zh: PDA TR43 的詞典不只是缺陷分類工具，它更是 供應商—製藥廠—法規機構 之間的共同語言。沒有標準化詞典，就像三方在說不同語言討論品質標準，無法達成一致。
blocks.en: The PDA TR43 lexicon is not just a defect classification tool; it is the common language between supplier, pharmaceutical company and regulator. Without a standardized lexicon, it is like three parties discussing quality criteria in different languages, with no way to reach agreement.

blocks.zh: 當 FDA 稽查員、EMA 審查員或客戶稽核員到工廠時，能引用 TR43 的具體缺陷名稱與分類是 GMP 成熟度的重要指標。
blocks.en: When an FDA inspector, EMA assessor or customer auditor visits the plant, being able to cite the specific defect names and classifications from TR43 is an important indicator of GMP maturity.

blocks.zh: 📚 Limit Sample（限量樣本）的角色
blocks.en: 📚 The Role of the Limit Sample

blocks.zh: 對許多 Minor 和 Acceptable Imperfection 缺陷，TR43 要求用 Limit Sample 判定，這是因為：
blocks.en: For many Minor and Acceptable Imperfection defects, TR43 requires a limit sample to be used for judgment, because:

blocks.zh: 這類缺陷的邊界難以用數字精確描述（如 Orange Peel 的深淺）
blocks.en: The boundaries of such defects are hard to describe precisely with numbers (such as the depth of Orange Peel)

blocks.zh: 目視判斷因人而異，需要實體界限樣本統一標準
blocks.en: Visual judgment varies from person to person, so a physical boundary sample is needed to unify the standard

blocks.zh: Limit Sample 是製藥廠與玻璃廠的契約性協議，具法律效力
blocks.en: A limit sample is a contractual agreement between the pharmaceutical company and the glass manufacturer and has legal force

blocks.zh: TR43 附錄特別指出：附錄中的照片不代表 Limit Sample，僅用於幫助讀者識別缺陷類型。
blocks.en: The TR43 appendix specifically notes that the photographs in the appendix do not represent limit samples; they are used only to help readers recognize defect types.

blocks.zh: 😇 模造玻璃製程中最常見的缺陷來源分析
blocks.en: 😇 Analysis of the Most Common Defect Sources in Moulded Glass Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 觀察 Table 8.0-1🔍 中的 Source 欄位，Moulding（模造成形） 是壓倒性的最主要來源，涵蓋幾乎所有尺寸型缺陷和表面型缺陷。
blocks.en: Looking at the Source column in Table 8.0-1🔍, Moulding is overwhelmingly the main source, covering almost all dimensional and surface-type defects.

blocks.zh: 這說明模造玻璃品質管制的核心在於：
blocks.en: This shows that the core of quality control for moulded glass lies in:
